resources.name: Quantum chemistry package with OVGF or ADC(3) capability

access.notes: Acceptable packages: ORCA (free), GAMESS (free), Gaussian (commercial, widely available), Psi4 (free via ADC). The package must support OVGF/TZVP or ADC(3)/cc-pVDZ calculations. The solving agent selects and installs the chosen package.
Molecular structure of bicyclo[2.2.2]octa-2,5-dione (C8H10O2). Can be generated from SMILES: O=C1CCC(=O)CC1 or from PubChem CID 137640. The agent builds a 3D initial geometry for optimization.
